key_insight: A stochastic network generator with user-defined directed hyperedges enables controlled tests of whether information-theoretic measures identify higher-order interactions and their source–target roles.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps validate higher-order network analysis methods against known mechanisms before applying them to empirical multivariate time series.
method: Specify pairwise and higher-order couplings in stochastic network dynamics.
Remove the higher-order term to create a pairwise-only reference for detection and recovery tests.
Compare product coupling with a specified nonlinear pairwise control matched in RMS coupling magnitude under the reference.
evidence_signal: Across tested topologies and coupling functions, several measures detected sufficiently strong higher-order interactions and, in a separate experiment, distinguished product coupling from the specified nonlinear pairwise control.
watch_item: Recovery became harder as candidate interactions increased, so detection alone should not be treated as reliable identification of the underlying mechanism.
paper_title: A Generative Model for Higher-Order Network Dynamics
